comments.note: DapperTagsRepository.cs: The two query methods (GetDeleteImpactAsync, GetMergeImpactAsync) now share ImpactRow cleanly. No issues found in the touched code.

summary: Reviewed DapperTagsRepository.cs — ImpactRow consolidation is clean, minimal, and correct. Single private sealed ImpactRow class replaces DeleteImpactRow and MergeImpactRow with no behavioral changes. OverlapMovies = 0 default is a well-documented forward-compatible placeholder. Build confirmed at zero warnings. Both ACs met.

comments.note: DapperTagsRepository.cs (ImpactRow): The explicit `= 0` initializer on OverlapMovies is technically redundant (int defaults to 0), but functions as an intentional documentation signal for WP-004. Acceptable as written — no change needed.

GetMergeImpactAsync: The `targetTagId` parameter is unused and carries a clear NOTE comment explaining the deferral to WP-004. C# does not warn on unused method parameters, so no warning is generated. The comment adequately documents intent.

notes: ImpactRow is now the single unified result class for both delete and merge impact queries in DapperTagsRepository.cs. It includes the new OverlapMovies = 0 property ready for WP-004 to populate via SQL. The two pre-existing CS8765 nullability warnings in VideoIndexer.Tests/TagsManagerTests.cs are unrelated to this change and were present before.

WP-001 PASS. ImpactRow unified class is in place with OverlapMovies = 0 placeholder ready for WP-004 to populate. No manifest updates required — ImpactRow is private and not part of the public API surface. Pipeline is implementation → code-review only; no release-engineering or documentation stages.
